```yaml
name: Release Morphic v1.0 with Ollama Provider Support

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v1.0'

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Build project
        run: yarn build

      - name: Test project
        run: yarn test

      - name: Add Ollama provider
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/nordwestt/ollama-ai-provider-v2.git
          cp -r ollama-ai-provider-v2/* lib/providers/
          rm -rf ollama-ai-provider-v2

      - name: Update provider registry
        run: |
          echo "import { OllamaProvider } from './providers/ollama';" >> lib/utils/registry.ts
          echo "export const providers = { ...providers, ollama: OllamaProvider };"

      - name: Update model configuration system
        run: |
          sed -i 's/"provider": "openai"/"provider": ["openai", "ollama"]/' config/default.json

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Restore Ollama Provider Support for v1.0"
          git push origin HEAD:v1.0

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/
          asset_name: morphic-v1.0.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip
```
